keys.manual_admin.tools.ia.title: AI
keys.manual_admin.tools.ia.desc: AI assistant configuration for question generation, with Groq or Gemini (Google).
keys.manual_admin.tools.ia.provider_desc: Choose which service generates the questions: Groq or Gemini.
keys.manual_admin.tools.ia.fallback_desc: If the active provider fails on a batch of questions (usage limit, error or timeout), the batch is retried with the other provider, as long as it has an API key. Enabled by default.
keys.manual_admin.tools.ia.key_desc: Access key for each provider. Groq keys start with gsk_ and Gemini keys with AQ.. You can store both at the same time.
keys.manual_admin.tools.ia.model_desc: Language model used by each provider.
